description: Repairs r-cat-1b/qd-create-invalid-sql: DBEngine.Errors read after QBadTable and QBadColumn (which succeed) repeated the earlier failure. On a writable copy of r-cat-1b-base, CreateQueryDef(name, sql) is called for each of: QBadSyntax = 'SELEC ID FROM T;' | QBadTable = 'SELECT ID FROM NoSuchTable;' | QBadColumn = 'SELECT NoSuchCol FROM T;' | QEmptySql = '' | QTwoStatements = 'SELECT ID FROM T; SELECT ID FROM U;' | QUnclosed = 'SELECT ID FROM T WHERE (ID > 1;'. DBEngine.Errors is read right before and right after each call, and the returned Name after it. QueryDefs (after Refresh) are then listed, and listed again after Close and a writable reopen.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
